name: 飞身肘击
description: 传送至地格（7）。对以自身为中心的3×3范围内：破墙，对敌人造成1倍伤害，然后移速+1。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,p=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:7,filter:'all'});if(!p||p.needsTargetSelection)return p;var tile=battle.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===p.x&&t.y===p.y;});if(!tile||!tile.props.walkable)return{success:false,message:'目标地格不可行走'};if(!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:c.instanceId,x:p.x,y:p.y}],'teleport').success)return{success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'};var cells=[];for(var dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(var dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)cells.push({x:c.x+dx,y:c.y+dy});flow.effects.destroyWalls(cells);var es=battle.pieces.filter(function(x){return x.currentHp>0&&!arePlayersAllied(battle,x.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId)&&Math.abs(x.x-c.x)<=1&&Math.abs(x.y-c.y)<=1});if(es.length)dealDamage(c,es,c.attack,'physical',battle,context.skill.id);c.moveRange=(c.moveRange||0)+1;return{success:true,message:c.name+'飞身肘击并破墙'};}
